title: 1,216 aspiring military officers pass PMA entrance exam

blocks.text: BAGUIO CITY — Around 1,216 young men and women passed this year’s Philippine Military Academy entrance examinations, the military school announced on Thursday. They make up 4.78 percent of the 25,452 qualified applicants who took exams in 48 testing centers from July to September 2026, said Navy Lt. Commdr Jermaine B Dacanay, acting chief of the PMA Public Affairs Office. The number of passing applicants in 2026 was lower than the 5.28 percent passing rate in 2025, Dacanay said. “This year, PMA received 36,596 online applications,” he said.
